one_liner: Early-stage accelerator in Paris for first-time founders.
what_it_is: A year-round accelerator that helps first-time founders go to market and grow from their first customers to a repeatable channel. Free to join, on application.

geography.notes: Paris venue, founders from France and Europe

icp.who: first-time founders of pre-seed startups in France

offer.core: Year-round support for go-to-market and growth, free to join, on application.
offer.price_model: free to join; swanbase takes equity in the startups it backs
differentiators: year-round, not a fixed batch sprint

positioning.against: going it alone or paying an agency
positioning.promise: from the first customers to a repeatable growth channel

voice.claims_policy: no invented stats, every metric must trace to a URL or be omitted
